title: Soy baked cod with mushrooms
summary: Soy baked cod with mushrooms is a japanese dinner built around cod fillets and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Soy baked cod with mushrooms into even pieces and toss chestnut mushrooms with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of chestnut mushrooms while you season cod fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle cod fillets and tamari among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Soy baked cod with mushrooms before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Soy baked cod with mushrooms into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
